title: India to Charge Kashmiri Woman's Family with Terrorism Over 35-Year-Old Rape and Murder Case
summary: The Jammu and Kashmir State Investigation Agency has prepared a 737-page charge sheet in the case of Sarla Bhat, a nurse who was abducted, tortured, and murdered in 1990. The agency is now set to present the chargesheet in court, which may lead to further legal action against Yasin Malik, one of the accused.
summary_points: A 35-year-old rape and murder case in Kashmir has been re-examined with a new charge sheet.
The Jammu and Kashmir State Investigation Agency has prepared a 737-page document detailing the allegations against Yasin Malik and three others.
Sarla Bhat, a nurse who was abducted and murdered in 1990, is at the center of the case.
The agency's investigation suggests that Malik and three others were involved in her murder.
The charge sheet may lead to further legal action against Malik.
title_hi: कश्मीर की सरला भट्ट हत्याकांड में 737 पन्नों की चार्जशीट दाखिल हो सकती है
summary_hi: जम्मू-कश्मीर के चर्चित सरला भट्ट हत्याकांड में जल्द ही चार्जशीट दाखिल की जा सकती है. सूत्रों के अनुसार, जम्मू-कश्मीर की स्टेट इन्वेस्टिगेशन एजेंसी (SIA) ने इस मामले में 737 पन्नों की विस्तृत चार्जशीट तैयार की है, जिसमें यासीन मलिक समेत चार अन्य लोगों की भूमिका की पुष्टि की गई है. जांच एजेंसी ने मौखिक साक्ष्य के आधार पर इस मामले में 35 साल बाद एक और मुकदमा चलाने की योजना बनाई है।

framing.center: Centrist outlets are highlighting the significance of the charge sheet and its potential impact on the case, as well as the agency's efforts to bring justice to Sarla Bhat's family.
